ai.title: AI providers
ai.description: Which AI service the assistant uses, its key, the models and what it may cost. Businesses never see the key.
ai.noAccess: Only the platform owner can manage the AI providers.
ai.loadFailed: The AI settings could not be loaded
ai.noDefault: No default provider is chosen and none is set in the environment, so the AI assistant is unavailable. Save a key for a provider, switch it on and make it the default.
ai.fromEnvironment: No default is chosen here, so the provider named in the server's environment ({{provider}}) is used. Choose a default below to manage it from this page.
ai.capReached: The monthly spending cap has been reached. AI requests are refused until next month or until you raise the cap.

quality.intro: Five fixed business questions in English and Swahili, answered by {{model}} against a made-up business. It checks numbers, tool use, refusing to invent and ignoring instructions hidden in records.
quality.cost: This sends {{questions}} real requests and costs about {{cost}}.

ai.formDescription: Choose the AI service Ziira uses. One provider is in use at a time. Businesses never see the key.

status.off: AI is off. Pick a provider, add its key and choose Save and use.

form.providerHint: The provider you pick here is the one in use for every business.
form.keyHint: Paste the key from the provider's dashboard. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.modelNameHint: Exactly as the provider names it. If the provider's list is known, the name must be in it.
form.price: About {{input}} in and {{output}} out per million tokens.
form.limit: Monthly spend limit in US dollars (optional)
form.limitHint: AI stops for everyone when this is reached. Leave empty for no limit. Spent this month: {{spend}}.
form.needKey: Add an API key to continue.
form.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
form.upToDate: Everything is saved and in use.
form.removeBody: The saved key is deleted. You will need to paste it again to use {{name}}.
form.removeInUse: This provider is in use, so choose another provider first. Removing its key is refused while it is in use.
form.consentsEnd: {{count}} business consent(s) given for the current provider will end. Those businesses are asked to agree again.
form.otherKeptUnused: Your {{name}} key is saved; it is not used.
